class.name: NNActions
class.description: The [method NoodleNodes.get_blackboard] family and [method NoodleNodes.get_actor] resolve through the owning [NNAgent] and its effective board and actor.

members.member: Marks the action as failed. Also set [member is_finished] to [code]true[/code] so the behaviour or action group stops waiting on it and handles the failure. On [NNAction], this flag is reset to [code]false[/code] when the action starts (before [signal NNAction.action_entered]) and when the action ends (after [signal NNAction.action_exited], so exit listeners can still read it). On [NNActionGroup], it is set automatically when a child fails under [code]EndExecution[/code] and is reset to [code]false[/code] when the group starts, so a failure from an earlier run does not carry over.

Marks the action as finished so the behaviour or action group can advance on the next [method NNAgent.update_current_behaviour] call. On [NNAction], this flag is reset to [code]false[/code] when the action starts (before [signal NNAction.action_entered]) and when the action ends (after [signal NNAction.action_exited], so exit listeners can still read it).
